name: Kobus Von Willingh
title: Owner & Master Barber
bio: Known for clean fades, sharp line-ups, and cuts tailored to you — not just the trend — he brings old-school technique and modern style to every appointment. Calm, focused, and detail-driven, Kobus makes sure you leave looking sharp and feeling confident.
bioShort: Kobus Von Willingh delivers clean fades, sharp details, and cuts that suit your style — every time.
